import NKU_HeaderStep
import NKU_DigestBody
import NKK_ClauseRoot
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NKU_ResumeRoot
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 NID_ResumeEmission NJU_ResumeObserved
open NKU_Chronology
/-- Whole native parent G, expressed as a chronological state fold. Every
stage receives the preceding returned NKU.State; rejected/aborted prefixes
short-circuit before later stages. There is no source suffix left in G. -/
def suffix {H : Type} (d : AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H)
 (s : NKU.State) : Run (core.result.Result NKU.Pair verifier.Error) :=
 match s.decoded.next,s.decoded.endAt with
 | some next,some «end» => NKU_DigestBody.run d hash s next «end»
 | _,_ => liftM (Result.fail .panic)
def G {H : Type} (d : AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H)
 (s : NKU.State) : Run (core.result.Result NKU.Pair verifier.Error) := do
 let reply ← NKU_HeaderStep.run d s
 NKK_Try.emitted reply (fun (_,post)=>suffix d hash post)
theorem suffix_eq {H : Type} (d : AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
 (hash : H) (s : NKU.State) : NKU_HeaderStep.suffix d hash s=suffix d hash s := by
 unfold NKU_HeaderStep.suffix suffix
 cases s.decoded.next with
 | none => rfl
 | some next =>
  cases s.decoded.endAt with
  | none => rfl
  | some «end» => exact NKU_DigestBody.source d hash s next «end»
/-- Forward native-G/source association, full Result AND chronological events.
All child Results are instantiated internally at SAME arguments. -/
theorem source {H : Type} (d : AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
 (hash : H) (s : NKU.State) :
 G d hash s=NJU_ResumeObserved.run s.frame.reservation d s.frame.checkpoint s.frame.proof s.frame.publicBytes .S2 hash := by
 symm
 rw [NKU_HeaderStep.source]
 unfold G
 apply NKK_LogAlgebra.bind_congr
 intro reply
 cases reply with
 | Err err => rfl
 | Ok pair => exact suffix_eq d hash pair.2
/-- The concrete child clauses are outputs of the parent theorem, never a
root hypothesis or a second independently selected successful invocation. -/
theorem clauses {H : Type} (d : AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
 (hash : H) (s : NKU.State) :
 NKK_LogClauses.Holds (NKK_Clauses.Clause s.frame.reservation d hash) (G d hash s) := by
 rw [source]
 exact (NKK_ClauseRoot.source s.frame.reservation d s.frame.checkpoint s.frame.proof s.frame.publicBytes .S2 hash).1
/-- Adopted cohort transport of this SAME complete parent fold. -/
theorem cohort {H : Type} (d : AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
 (hash : H) (s : NKU.State) :
 NIL_StatePort.reply (G d hash s).result=
 AspisR1Stage2.verifier.resumeWithOps (CheckpointBytes4Ops.ops (NJC_FilledClause.reserved s.frame.reservation))
 d s.frame.checkpoint s.frame.proof s.frame.publicBytes .S2 hash := by
 rw [source]
 exact NJU_ResumeRoot.cohort s.frame.reservation d s.frame.checkpoint s.frame.proof s.frame.publicBytes hash

#print source
#print clauses
#print cohort
#print axioms suffix_eq
#print axioms source
#print axioms clauses
#print axioms cohort

import NJU_ResumeObserved
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NKU
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 NID_ResumeEmission
abbrev K := aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev E := aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
abbrev Pair := verifier.Prepared × verifier.Accumulator
/-- One immutable invocation frame. Reservation is the actual allocator item,
not a newly chosen outcome at the allocation site. -/
structure Frame where
 checkpoint : Slice U8
 proof : Slice U8
 publicBytes : Slice U8
 reservation : NP6_StdModel.Reservation
/-- All entered NKK occurrences use the existing typed event constructors;
terminal/cleanup observations retain the full returned value. -/
inductive Event where
 | call (event : NJU_ResumeObserved.Event)
 | terminal (reply : Result (core.result.Result Pair verifier.Error))
 | cleanup (weights : alloc.vec.Vec K)
inductive Phase where
 | header | proofDigest | publicDigest | checkpointDigest | roots | fields
 | queries | validator | semantic | zClaim | filled | weights | tail | terminal
structure Decoded where
 next : Option U8 := none
 endAt : Option Usize := none
 roots : List (Array U8 32#usize) := []
 gammaAlpha : List E := []
 rho : Option K := none
 queries : List U32 := []
 semantic : Option (Array K 10#usize) := none
 z : List K := []
 claim : Option E := none
 rhs : Option E := none
 power : Option K := none
/-- Single parent carrier: immutable inputs, decoded slots, Reader/backing,
iterator, owned allocation and complete terminal status. No callee reply is
assumed successful. -/
structure State where
 frame : Frame
 phase : Phase := .header
 decoded : Decoded := {}
 reader : verifier.Reader
 iterator : Option (core.slice.iter.Iter U8) := none
 owned : Option (alloc.vec.Vec K) := none
 returned : Option (Result (core.result.Result Pair verifier.Error)) := none
 history : List Event := []
def initial (frame : Frame) : State :=
 { frame, reader := { bytes := frame.checkpoint, «at» := 0#usize } }
def headerPost (s : State) (next : U8) («end» : Usize) : State :=
 { s with phase := .proofDigest, decoded := {s.decoded with next := some next, endAt := some «end»} }
theorem header_frame (s : State) (next : U8) («end» : Usize) :
 (headerPost s next «end»).frame=s.frame ∧
 (headerPost s next «end»).reader=s.reader ∧
 (headerPost s next «end»).owned=s.owned := ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩
#print axioms header_frame
end NKU

import NKV_LoopTransport
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NKV_ReturnBoundary
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1Stage2
open NKV_StepErasure NKV_LoopTransport

def returned (x : Out) : Result (Reply × Indices × Values) :=
 ok (x.2.2.1,x.1,x.2.1)

def cohort (x : Out) : Result (Reply × Indices × Values) :=
 match eraseOut x with
 | (i,v,none) => fail .panic
 | (i,v,some r) => ok (r,i,v)

/-- Consumer rejection observation retains every successful mutable value.
It does not modify the adopted cohort or claim all its errors are Result.fail. -/
def reject : Result (Reply × Indices × Values) → Result (Unit × Indices × Values)
 | .ok (.Ok u,i,v) => ok (u,i,v)
 | .ok (.Err _,_,_) => fail .panic
 | .fail e => fail e
 | .div => div

def WellClassified (x : Out) : Prop := x.2.2.2=true → x.2.2.1≠.Ok ()

theorem preserved (i : Indices) (v : Values) (r : Reply) :
 cohort (i,v,r,false)=returned (i,v,r,false) := rfl

theorem lost (i : Indices) (v : Values) (r : Reply) :
 cohort (i,v,r,true)=fail .panic := rfl

/-- The duplicate Err arm is preserved by the actual pending-return boundary.
Thus a literal all-errors iff Result.fail statement is false at this boundary. -/
theorem duplicate_preserved (i : Indices) (v : Values) :
 cohort (i,v,.Err .Merkle,false)=ok (.Err .Merkle,i,v) ∧
 cohort (i,v,.Err .Merkle,false)≠fail .panic := by
 exact ⟨rfl,by intro h;cases h⟩

theorem observed (x : Out) (well : WellClassified x) :
 reject (cohort x)=reject (returned x) := by
 rcases x with ⟨i,v,r,b⟩
 cases b with
 | false => rfl
 | true =>
   cases r with
   | Err e => rfl
   | Ok u => cases u;exact (well rfl rfl).elim

/-- Identical ordered-effects and oracle-query events; terminal observation
adds no event. Event can be a sum carrying both event classes. -/
def observeTrace {Event : Type} (events : List Event)
 (out : Result (Reply × Indices × Values)) := (events,reject out)

theorem prefix_transport {Event : Type} (events : List Event) (x : Out)
 (well : WellClassified x) :
 observeTrace events (cohort x)=observeTrace events (returned x) := by
 unfold observeTrace
 rw [observed x well]

set_option pp.proofs false
#print observed
#print prefix_transport
#print axioms preserved
#print axioms lost
#print axioms duplicate_preserved
#print axioms observed
#print axioms prefix_transport
end NKV_ReturnBoundary
end

namespace NKV_ParentSource

abbrev Step := Result Return

def observe : Result Reply → Result Unit
 | .ok (.Ok u) => ok u | .ok (.Err _) => fail .panic
 | .fail e => fail e | .div => div

def next (m : Step) (k : Indices → Values → Result Reply) : Result Reply := do
 let (r,i,v) ← m
 match r with | .Ok _ => k i v | .Err e => ok (.Err e)

theorem next_observed (m : Step) (k : Indices → Values → Result Reply) :
 observe (next m k)=(do let (_,i,v) ← reject m; observe (k i v)) := by
 cases m with
 | fail e => rfl
 | div => rfl
 | ok out =>
   rcases out with ⟨r,i,v⟩
   cases r <;> rfl

theorem next_congr (m n : Step) (f g : Indices → Values → Result Reply)
 (head : reject m=reject n) (tail : ∀ i v,observe (f i v)=observe (g i v)) :
 observe (next m f)=observe (next n g) := by
 rw [next_observed,next_observed,head]

 | fail e => rfl
 | div => rfl
 | ok out => rcases out with ⟨u,i,v⟩;exact tail i v

 (do let (r,i,v) ← m

abbrev Caller := Indices → Values → Step
abbrev zeroI : Indices := Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32
abbrev zeroV : Values := Array.repeat 16#usize (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8)

def three (c0 c1 c2 : Caller) : Result Reply := do
 let (r,idx1,val1) ← c0 zeroI zeroV
 let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r

       Unit (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual

   core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual

   (fun i v => next (c2 i v) (fun _ _ => ok (.Ok ())))) := by

 (first : ∀ i v,reject (a0 i v)=reject (b0 i v))
 (second : ∀ i v,reject (a1 i v)=reject (b1 i v))
 (third : ∀ i v,reject (a2 i v)=reject (b2 i v)) :
